scope: Archived Re=20 static immersed-marker cylinder verification from missions m18749 and m18779. The board audit recorded a failed drag comparison and a failed convergence criterion. The separately archived Re=100 LIFE script does not reproduce this case. Current acceptance remains unevaluated.

drag_relative_error.metric: Percent error versus the historical 2.05 drag reference

drag_variation.metric: Drag coefficient variation over the last 2000 time steps

references.value: Dennis and Chang (1970), Journal of Fluid Mechanics 42:471, Cd=2.05 as recorded by mission m18749
